title: 第3章 赵清洵
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

赵清洵离开那天，许存意偷偷跑去了机场，她看到了跟他同行的那个女生。

漂亮，明艳。

许存意记得她，她是赵妈妈朋友的女儿，叫贺舒。在她十八岁生日宴上出现过，那时没觉得他们之间有什么关系。

所以，她一直就是小丑。

现在他们挽着手，光明正大的在一起。

“我还以为你真的喜欢上她了。”

“不会。”

“真的一点都没有吗？”

“没有。”

赵清洵接起电话，许存意能清晰的听到电话里的人，说：“你还没好吗？这边好像不能长时间停车，有交警来提醒了。”

赵清洵应了一声，说：“你该考驾照了。”

他的语气里带着一种无可奈何的宠溺。

许存意已经不记得他以前对她是否也这样，就算有应该也是演的。

他一边说话一边往外走。

许存意则默不作声的跟在他身后，听他讲完电话，把他送到门口。进电梯之前，赵清洵似是想到什么，从口袋里拿出门卡递给她，“进门密码是我的生日。”

“还记得吗？”

许存意接过门卡，以前是记得的，“不记得了。”

赵清洵微微一笑，说：“没关系，重新

他说着，突兀的伸手过来，拨掉了黏在她唇上的发丝。

指腹划过唇瓣，触感稍纵即逝。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

On the day Zhao Qingxun left, Xu Cunyi secretly ran to the airport, and she saw the girl who was traveling with him.

Beautiful and bright.

Xu Cunyi remembered her. She was the daughter of Zhao's mother's friend, named He Shu.He showed up at her eighteenth birthday party, but I didn't think there was any relationship between them at that time.

So, she has always been the clown.

Now they hold hands and are together openly.

"I thought you really liked her."

"No."

"Really not at all?"

"No."

Zhao Qingxun answered the phone, and Xu Cunyi could clearly hear the person on the phone saying, "Are you okay yet? It seems that you can't park for a long time here. The traffic police have come to remind you."

Zhao Qingxun responded and said, "It's time for you to get your driver's license."

There was a helpless doting in his tone.

Xu Cunyi couldn't remember whether he had treated her like this before. Even if he did, it was just an act.

He walked out while talking.

Xu Cunyi followed him silently, listened to him finish the phone call, and sent him to the door.Before entering the elevator, Zhao Qingxun seemed to have thought of something and took out the key card from his pocket and handed it to her, "The entry code is my birthday."

"Remember?"

Xu Cunyi took the key card. He remembered it before, "I don't remember."

Zhao Qingxun smiled slightly and said, "It doesn't matter. Let's start again."

As he spoke, he reached out abruptly and brushed off the hair stuck to her lips.

The fingertips passed across the lips, and the touch was fleeting.
